notes.VADER: English lexicon/rule-based method; configured thresholds -0.05 and 0.05.

Ollama.prompt: Classify the sentiment expressed in each YouTube comment about the announcement about the remake of The legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Return exactly one label per item: negative, neutral, or positive. Judge the author's expressed opinion, not the topic. Questions or factual statements without clear polarity are neutral. Consider negation, emojis, slang, and irony; if irony is ambiguous, choose neutral. Do not infer sentiment that is not expressed. Return a JSON object with a results array; each element must contain the input id and its label.
